en.headline: Hong Kong students watch Tiananmen flag-raising on Beijing visit
en.dek: Education Secretary Choi Yuk-lin led a Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-team delegation of more than 1,300 people at the square on Sunday.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮率港澳升旗隊訪京團在天安門觀升旗
zh.dek: 訪京團超過1300名港澳師生周日在天安門廣場觀看升旗儀式，五日行程由18日至22日。

en.headline: AFCD and police catch three dogs after Yuen Long cyclist death
en.dek: Officers detained three adult mongrels overnight near Pok Wai South Road and will check for microchips as the inquiry continues.

zh.headline: 漁護署聯同警方元朗據獲三隻成年唐狗
zh.dek: 行動於壩圍南路一帶通宵進行，狗隻送往動物管理中心觀察，署方會查晶片並跟進調查。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for isolated New Territories storms
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 7:10am, valid until 9am, and forecast a mainly cloudy, hot day with a few showers.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界局部地區有雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於上午7時10分發出，有效至上午9時；今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，日間炎熱最高約32度。

en.headline: Autumn Home Expo opens at Convention Centre this Thursday
en.dek: More than 600 exhibitors covering furnishings, smart home and interior design will gather from 24 to 27 September, with a special display of state banquet porcelain used by the Chinese and Russian presidents.

zh.headline: 秋季家居博覽周四會展開鑼 展出中俄元首用瓷
zh.dek: 9月24至27日於會展舉行，逾600家展商涵蓋建材、智能家居及室內設計，另有國宴瓷系列公開展出。

en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns this week for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: The 67-metre incense-lit dragon will parade through Tai Hang streets from 24 to 26 September, with live broadcasts and a gala night on the festival day itself.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍本周上演 中秋三晚巡遊
zh.dek: 67米長香火龍將於9月24至26日在大坑街巷巡遊，中秋正日另有晚會及直播安排。

en.headline: Customs seizes suspected infringing jewellery worth HK$160,000 at Wan Chai fair
en.dek: Officers arrested a man and a woman after finding about 27 items at a booth of the Jewellery & Gem World Hong Kong September exhibition and a related company in Hung Hom.

zh.headline: 海關會展檢獲約16萬元懷疑侵權首飾 拘兩男女
zh.dek: 關員於灣仔會展「九月香港珠寶首飾展覽會」攤位及紅磡相關公司檢獲約27件懷疑侵權首飾，包括耳環、手鐲及頸鏈。

en.headline: Customs seizes 13kg suspected ketamine at airport, Japanese man arrested
en.dek: Officers found the drugs, valued at about HK$4.7 million, in the checked luggage of a 22-year-old passenger arriving from Frankfurt on Sunday.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲13公斤疑似氯胺酮 拘22歲日本籍男子
zh.dek: 周日一名由法蘭克福抵港乘客行李內發現市值約470萬元懷疑氯胺酮，男子已被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games silver in 4x100m freestyle relay
en.dek: Siobhan Haughey and teammates clock a Hong Kong record 3:36.59 for the city’s second medal of the Nagoya Games, finishing behind China.

zh.headline: 港隊女子4x100米自由泳接力摘銀 亞運第二面獎牌
zh.dek: 何詩蓓與隊友以3分36秒59刷新香港紀錄，僅次於中國隊，為港隊再添一銀。

en.headline: Hong Kong signs protocol giving firms equal treatment across ASEAN
en.dek: The First Protocol to the ASEAN-Hong Kong Investment Agreement activates national treatment and most-favoured-nation provisions for non-services sectors in the 10 member states.

zh.headline: 香港簽署東盟投資協定議定書 企業享國民及最惠待遇
zh.dek: 《修訂香港與東盟投資協定的第一議定書》今日在馬尼拉簽署，啓動非服務業領域的國民待遇及最惠待遇條款。

en.headline: Local trio Midnight Cowboy plays album live at West Kowloon tonight
en.dek: The indie band performs a full reading of its debut record See You Down The Road at The Box in Freespace, setting Hong Kong poet Yam Gong’s verse to rock.

zh.headline: 本地組合Midnight Cowboy今晚西九演譯首張專輯
zh.dek: 三人組合於自由空間盒子演出首張專輯《See You Down The Road》全曲，將香港詩人飲江詩句配以搖滾及粵語口白。

en.headline: Abby Choi murder trial to open at High Court this week
en.dek: The ex-husband, father-in-law and brother-in-law of the late model face a joint murder charge; the first hearing is set for Monday with the case expected to last about 45 days.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案下週高院開審 前夫等三人被控謀殺
zh.dek: 蔡天鳳前夫、前家翁及前大伯被控謀殺及阻止合法殮葬，周一先處理程序事宜，全案料審約45日。

en.headline: Police say woman killed by dogs while cycling in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 27-year-old woman died after being chased and mauled by several dogs near Nam Sang Wai; officers are working with the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to catch the animals.

zh.headline: 元朗女子踩單車疑遭野狗襲擊身亡 警聯同漁護署捉狗
zh.dek: 27歲女子凌晨在壆圍南路倒卧不治，閉路電視顯示她曾被約三隻狗追趕，頭頸有致命咬傷，警方正與漁護署合作捕捉涉事犬隻。

en.headline: Paul Chan says five-year plan gives firms longer-term investment certainty
en.dek: The financial secretary wrote that the blueprint's targets and timelines help businesses align decisions with government goals amid a volatile external environment.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：五年規劃為企業提供更長遠投資確定性
zh.dek: 財政司司長在周日網誌指，規劃的目標及時間表有助企業在外部環境波動下，與政府方向對齊投資決定。

en.headline: Grace Lau wins Hong Kong's first Asian Games medal with karate silver
en.dek: The world number one took silver in the women's individual kata final in Nagoya after a 0-5 defeat by Japan's Maho Ono, upgrading her previous two bronzes.

zh.headline: 劉慕裳空手道個人形奪銀 香港亞運首面獎牌
zh.dek: 世界排名第一的劉慕裳在名古屋亞運會女子個人形決賽以0比5不敵日本選手小野真步，為香港帶來本屆亞運首面獎牌。

en.headline: Work week set for mainly cloudy days with showers and milder heat
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects a few showers and isolated thunderstorms early in the week, with temperatures generally between 27 and 31 degrees and sunny intervals at times.

zh.headline: 未來工作天大致多雲有驟雨 氣溫回落至27至31度
zh.dek: 天文台預料本週初有幾陣驟雨及局部雷暴，日間短暫有陽光，氣溫普遍介乎27至31度，星期三起天色漸轉好。

en.headline: Census office warns of fake population census website
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said a fraudulent site is circulating and has referred the matter to police; genuine contacts use only the 18 2026 hotline.

zh.headline: 統計處籲提防偽冒人口普查網站
zh.dek: 政府統計處指有虛假網址及冒認電郵短訊流傳，已交警方跟進；正式聯絡只會顯示18 2026或發送人「#C&SD」。

en.headline: Moonlit Bunny Crew lights Cultural Centre piazza until October
en.dek: The LCSD Mid-Autumn installation by local studio STICKYLINE runs from 17 September to 11 October, switched on each evening from 6.30pm.

zh.headline: 文化中心露天廣場「月影兔攝隊」亮燈至十月
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處指裝置由本地團隊STICKYLINE設計，9月17日至10月11日展出，每晚6時半亮燈。

en.headline: Man, 30, arrested after Yuen Long street slashing
en.dek: Police detained a local man in Sheung Shui on Saturday over Friday night's attack on a woman outside a school in Fung Nin Road.

zh.headline: 元朗豐年路斬人案 警在上水拘30歲男子
zh.dek: 31歲女子周五晚在商會中學對開遭利器襲擊，左手臂受傷；男子涉嫌傷人，現正被扣留調查。

en.headline: Woman found beside share bike in Yuen Long dies in hospital
en.dek: Police are investigating whether she crashed while riding alone or was involved in another incident after a passer-by raised the alarm just after midnight.

zh.headline: 元朗女子倒卧共享單車旁送院不治
zh.dek: 途人凌晨在壩圍南路報案，警方調查事主是否獨自踩單車失控，抑或涉及其他事故。

en.headline: Flag-draped coffin leaves North Point after Tung state funeral
en.dek: The public memorial began at 9am at Hong Kong Funeral Home; John Lee was among the pallbearers as the hearse departed at 10.13am.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬完成 國旗覆蓋靈柴離開北角
zh.dek: 公祭大殓今早九時在北角香港殮儀館福海堂舉行，李家超等扶靈，靈車約十時十三分離開。

en.headline: Shek Kip Mei art village hangs 100 hand-painted Mid-Autumn lanterns
en.dek: JCCAC's courtyard display runs until 27 September, lighting up from 6pm, with lantern riddles and a retro photo set on the second-floor terrace.

zh.headline: 石硜尾藝術村掛起百盎手繪中秋燈籠
zh.dek: 賽馬會創意藝術中心庭園展出至9月27日，每晚6時亮燈，並設燈謎及二樓懷舊酒吧佈景，免費參觀。

en.headline: Tang says Huanggang systems still being tuned, border hours under talks
en.dek: The security chief said computer and camera adjustments are under way at the rebuilt port, and Hong Kong is discussing longer land-crossing hours with the mainland.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：新皇崗口岸仍在調校系統 正商延長陸路通關
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示演練整體暢順，人面識別鏡頭及五合一車道仍須微調；陸路口岸延長服務時間正與內地商討。

en.headline: Metal debris on Tolo Highway punctures more than 10 cars
en.dek: Police took reports from Saturday evening after drivers heading towards Sheung Shui hit objects near the Tai Po South exit. No one was hurt.

zh.headline: 吐露港公路疑有金屬物 十多車爆胎無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚約8時起，往上水方向近大埔南出口有多輛車輪胎被硬物刺穿，現場一度出現車龍。

en.headline: Two pig-transport trucks overturn within four hours
en.dek: A 55-year-old driver was slightly hurt on Fanling Highway before a second truck flipped at Nathan Road in Yau Ma Tei.

zh.headline: 四小時內兩運豬車翻側 粉嶺公路司機輕傷
zh.dek: 粉嶺公路近康樂園一車翻側，55歲司機右手輕傷；其後油麻地彌敦道再有同類貨車撞欄翻側。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued as Sunday peaks near 33C
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 7:30am, saying very hot weather is expected and urging people to watch for heat stroke.

zh.headline: 天文台今早發出酷熱天氣警告 市區料高見33度
zh.dek: 警告於上午7時30分發出，預料今日天氣酷熱，市民須慎防中暑；黃色火災危險警告仍然生效。

en.headline: Greater Bay Area legal exam held as Lam urges more lawyers to sit it
en.dek: The sixth sitting took place in Shenzhen and Zhuhai on Saturday; the secretary for justice said an amended Mainland lawyers law supports regularising the scheme.

zh.headline: 大灣區律師執業考試舉行 林定國籲更多港律師報考
zh.dek: 第六屆考試周六在深圳及珠海舉行；律政司司長指內地修訂後的律師法為制度恆常化提供法律基礎。

en.headline: Wan Chai Blue House hangs 700 hand-painted Mid-Autumn lanterns
en.dek: The cluster on Stone Nullah Lane lights up from 6pm to 9.30pm until 14 October, stretching into nearby side streets.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋掛出700盎手繪中秋花燈
zh.dek: 石水渠街建築群花燈展期至10月14日，每晚6時至9時半亮燈，並延伸至附近橫街。

en.headline: Cathay retains world's third-best airline title in Skytrax awards
en.dek: The Hong Kong carrier also took world's best cabin crew and best first-class lounge, as Singapore Airlines reclaimed first place.

zh.headline: 國泰連續第二年獲Skytrax全球第三佳航空公司
zh.dek: 國泰同時奪得全球最佳空中服務員及全球最佳頭等貴賓室；新加坡航空重奪總榜第一。

en.headline: No special road closures near Cape Collinson today, government says
en.dek: A spokesman dismissed online claims that hearses and coaches would be barred from the Chai Wan crematorium area on Sunday morning.

zh.headline: 政府澄清哥連臣角今日沒有特別封路
zh.dek: 發言人否認網傳周日早上禁止靈車及旅遊巴士進入柴灣火葬場一帶的說法。

en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning issued again on a dry, hot Sunday
en.dek: The Observatory said the fire risk is high after issuing the warning at 6am, as an anticyclone keeps southern China mainly fine.

zh.headline: 天文台再發黃色火災危險警告 周日乾燥酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台今早6時發出黃色火災危險警告，指火警風險頗高；高空反氣旋令華南大致天晴。

en.headline: State funeral for Tung Chee-hwa proceeds today after Saturday vigil
en.dek: Public memorial and encoffining begin at 9am at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, with condolence books open until noon at designated centres.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬今日舉行 公祭大殮上午九時開始
zh.dek: 北角香港殯儀館福海堂今日上午九時舉行公祭大殮後出殯，市民可繼續在指定地點簽署弔唁冊至中午。

en.headline: 251 civil servants dismissed over five years for misconduct or crime
en.dek: Civil Service Bureau figures show 48 dismissals in the latest financial year alone, while a streamlined process has led to five compulsory retirements for persistent underperformance.

zh.headline: 五年內251名公務員因不當行為或定罪被免職
zh.dek: 公務員事務局向立法會提交的數字顯示，最近一個財政年度有48宗免職個案，簡化程序下已有五人因表現持續欠佳被勒令退休。

en.headline: Customs seizes 10 endangered live turtles at airport from US parcel
en.dek: Officers found the suspected scheduled species inside a carton declared as women's knitted tops; the case was referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢10隻懷疑瀕危活龜 來源美國包裹
zh.dek: 關員在報稱載有女裝針織短袖上衣的紙箱內發現該批活龜，案件已交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Kwun Tong waterfront hosts Mid-Autumn carnival today
en.dek: The Kwun Tong District Arts and Culture Promotion Association stages games, workshops, magic, dance and Sichuan opera face-changing at AquaBeat 01 on the harbourfront.

zh.headline: 觀塘海濱今日舉行中秋繽紛嘉年華
zh.dek: 觀塘區文娛康樂促進會於AquaBeat 01舉辦提早慶祝中秋活動，設燈謎、手作、魔術、舞蹈及川劇變臉等節目。

en.headline: Customs seizes 7kg cannabis at airport, arrests three mainland men
en.dek: Two separate cases today involved passengers arriving from Bangkok with suspected cannabis buds hidden in snack packaging inside carry-on bags.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢約7公斤大麻花拘三名內地男子
zh.dek: 今日兩宗個案，三名由曼谷抵港的內地男子在手提行李零食包裝內藏有懷疑大麻花，合共約7公斤，市值約140萬元。

en.headline: Customs seizes 50kg silver ingots worth HK$1m at HZMB, driver charged
en.dek: A 30-year-old man was arrested after officers found the suspected smuggled silver hidden in the lower boot of an outgoing private car on 18 September.

zh.headline: 海關港珠澳大橋截出境私家車 檢50公斤銀磚值百萬拘司機
zh.dek: 海關前日在港珠澳大橋香港口岸截查一輛出境私家車，於車尾箱下層置物格發現約50公斤懷疑走私銀磚，市值約100萬元，30歲男司機已被控。

en.headline: LCSD launches Asian Games focal sites across 18 districts
en.dek: Public viewing hubs at designated sports centres open from 5pm today until 4 October, with a launch ceremony held at Hong Kong Park Sports Centre.

zh.headline: 康文署全港18區啟動活力亞運觀賞站
zh.dek: 指定體育館今日下午5時起開放至10月4日，香港公園體育館舉行啟動禮及全民動起來運動日。

en.headline: Good Hope School principal apologises over Cantonese ban wording in graduation video…
en.dek: Dr Gary Harfitt said an unedited internal slide containing the phrase “Cantonese is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN” was sent in error and does not reflect school policy.

zh.headline: 德望學校校長就畢業影片「禁用粵語」指引致歉
zh.dek: 校長Harfitt指未修訂簡報誤發予中六生，強調內容不符校方政策，校方從未禁止使用粵語。

en.headline: CHP confirms another mpox case as yearly total reaches 26
en.dek: A 25-year-old man is in stable condition after testing positive; health authorities again urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated amid a rise since August.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心再確診一宗猴痘個案 本年累計26宗
zh.dek: 25歲男子情況穩定，當局再呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗；八月以來新增17宗個案。

en.headline: Guangdong yachts expected to sail in Hong Kong waters from October
en.dek: Transport chief Mable Chan said the southbound scheme is close to launch after the Marine Department prepares to sign arrangements with Guangdong authorities.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下最快10月實施 陳美寶：詳情稍後公布
zh.dek: 海事處將與廣東海事局簽署工作安排，配合五年規劃發展遊艇經濟及跨境休閒消費。

en.headline: Driver arrested for drink-driving after crashing into Ma On Shan railing
en.dek: A 33-year-old man failed a breath test after his private car struck a roadside barrier near a police station on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山私家車撞欄 33歲司機涉醉駕被捕
zh.dek: 車輛於早上失控撞毀約1.5米欄杆，司機未能通過酒精呼氣測試，現正被扣留調查。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued as temperatures climb past 33C
en.dek: The Observatory raised the warning at 1pm, urging the public to watch for heat stroke while the Yellow Fire Danger Warning remains in force.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 多區氣溫逾33度
zh.dek: 警告於下午1時發出，黃色火災危險警告仍生效；市民應多補充水分，慎防中暑。

en.headline: Police smash Fanling meth lab, seize drugs worth HK$23m
en.dek: Three people were arrested after officers found solid and liquid methamphetamine plus active manufacturing equipment in a tin-sheet structure in Chi Tong Tsuen.

zh.headline: 警方搗粉嶺鐵皮屋製毒工場 檢值2300萬冰毒拘三人
zh.dek: 單位內製毒設備仍在運作，另檢大量化學品；三名被捕人據稱受金錢利誘加入，周一提堂。

en.headline: Customs seizes 535kg cannabis worth HK$125m in largest sea haul
en.dek: Three men were arrested in Mong Kok after officers found the drugs hidden in insulated boxes from a Thailand-bound container following a 16-day surveillance operation.

zh.headline: 海關破歷來最大宗海路大麻花案 檢535公斤值1.25億拘三人
zh.dek: 貨櫃由泰國抵港，部分保溫箱藏有定位器；經16日監控後於旺角唐樓拘三男，其中越南籍男子將被起訴。

en.headline: Jao Tsung-I Academy opens for Mid-Autumn lantern weekend
en.dek: The former Lai Chi Kok Hospital marks its 12th anniversary open days this weekend with hand-painted lanterns, a craft market and free heritage tours.

zh.headline: 饕館今起開放日迎中秋 花燈與市集同步
zh.dek: 美孚饕宗頫文化館十二周年開放日今明兩日及25、26日舉行，有市民繪製花燈、手作市集及免費古跡導賞。

en.headline: Chan says carer canteens aim to spot people who need help
en.dek: A three-month trial at a Shek Pai Wan youth centre served 250 people and issued 2,200 meal coupons, the chief secretary said on Saturday.

zh.headline: 陳國基：照顧者飯堂要識別需支援人士
zh.dek: 政務司司長周六表示，香港仔石排灣青年中心試行三個月，250人使用服務，派出2,200張飯券。

en.headline: Two arrested after 160km/h run on Kwun Tong Bypass
en.dek: East Kowloon traffic police said one driver more than doubled the 80km/h limit and weaved between lanes during Operation Fei Shield on 17 and 18 September.

zh.headline: 觀塘繞道反危駕拘兩男 有車時速160公里
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部指，17至18日「飛盾」行動中，一名司機在限速80公里路段車速達160公里或以上，並在行車線之間穿插。

en.headline: Small LED fire dragon performs at Victoria Park this weekend
en.dek: A children’s LED dragon takes the soccer pitches at 7pm on Saturday and Sunday, as the Mid-Autumn creative market also opens in the park this evening.

zh.headline: 維園今明兩晚演小型LED火龍 中秋市集同日開檔
zh.dek: 旅發局指今晚及週日晚上7時於維園五、六號足球場演小型LED火龍；康文署中秋創意市集今晚6時半起開放。

en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning in force as weekend stays dry and hot
en.dek: The government said the fire risk is high today and urged hikers to stay alert, as the Observatory forecast sunny weather with urban highs around 32 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 郊遊人士須小心
zh.dek: 當局指今日火警風險高，呼籲市民小心防火；天文台預料天晴乾燥炎熱，市區最高約32度。

en.headline: Lee says five-year plan has 105 indicators drawn from mainland practice
en.dek: The chief executive told RTHK the targets were adapted to Hong Kong conditions and would be delivered through annual Policy Address goals, in a roughly three-to-one ratio.

zh.headline: 李家超：五年規劃105項指標參考內地經驗
zh.dek: 特首在《星期六問責》表示，指標按香港實況制定，並透過每年施政報告落實，比例約為三比一。

en.headline: Lee says crackdown on poor subdivided flats will not leave tenants homeless
en.dek: On RTHK’s Saturday Accountability, the chief executive said the government would not use extreme or high-handed means and cited a 65 percent registration rate under the Basic Housing Unit regime.

zh.headline: 李家超：取締劣質劌房不會用高壓手段
zh.dek: 特首在港台《星期六問責》表示，不會因取締劣質劌房而令住戶無瓦遮頭，簡樸房登記率現達65%。

en.headline: Vigil for Tung Chee-hwa begins this afternoon in North Point
en.dek: A wake runs from 3pm at Hong Kong Funeral Home, with a memorial service and cortege scheduled for Sunday morning.

zh.headline: 董建華設靈今日北角舉行
zh.dek: 香港殮儀館福海堂下午3時起設靈，週日上午舉行公祭及出殮。

en.headline: Woman wounded in Yuen Long street attack, suspect still at large
en.dek: Police classified the Friday night incident on Fung Nin Road as wounding and are seeking a man aged about 20 to 30.

zh.headline: 元朗豐年路女子遇襲受傷 疑犯在逃
zh.dek: 警方將周五晚案件列作傷人，正追緙一名約20至30歲男子。

en.headline: Lam says existing laws already cover AI-aided crime
en.dek: The secretary for justice said dedicated AI statutes may follow if needed, as the Law Reform Commission studies deepfake pornography and scams.

zh.headline: 林定國：現行法例已可處理利用AI犯罪
zh.dek: 律政司司長表示，即使尚未有專門規管人工智能的法例，亦不代表出現真空；法律改革委員會正研究深偽色情及騙案。

en.headline: Foreign elderly carers to earn 10-20pc more than helpers
en.dek: Chris Sun said a pilot next year would admit trained overseas carers with at least three years' elderly-care experience, modelled on the domestic helper regime.

zh.headline: 外籍家居照顧員擬較外傭薪高一至兩成
zh.dek: 孫玉蕾表示，明年試行輸入具認可護老培訓及至少三年經驗的外籍家居照顧員，制度參照現有外傭安排。

en.headline: Rooftop Moonlit Market opens in Lai Chi Kok for Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: The Hive Lai Chi Kok hosts a free-entry family-friendly market with local food, crafts, workshops and carnival games on Saturday afternoon and evening.

zh.headline: 荔枝角天台月光市集周末登場 迎中秋
zh.dek: The Hive荔枝角今日下午至晚上舉辦親子友善市集，有本地美食、手工藝、工作坊及嘉年華遊戲，入場免費但需預先登記。

en.headline: Two more mpox cases confirmed, CHP urges high-risk groups to vaccinate
en.dek: A 28-year-old and a 26-year-old man are in isolation after high-risk sexual contacts in Hong Kong; 16 cases have been recorded since August.

zh.headline: 再增兩宗猴痘確診 防護中心籲高風險群組接種疫苗
zh.dek: 28歲及26歲男子分別因高風險性行為感染，現於醫院隔離治療；八月至今累計16宗新個案。

en.headline: 72-year-old pedestrian dies after Tai Po light goods vehicle collision
en.dek: The woman, knocked down at a crossing on On Tai Road, was pronounced dead at Prince of Wales Hospital; the 68-year-old driver remains under arrest for dangerous driving.

zh.headline: 大埔輕型貨車撞72歲女途人 送院後不治
zh.dek: 事主於安泰路行人過路處被撞倒，頭部重傷昏迷，傍晚於威爾斯親王醫院不治；68歲男司機涉危險駕駛被捕。

en.headline: Prince of Wales patient dies after being given normal meal instead of pureed food
en.dek: A 54-year-old man with swallowing difficulties choked and suffered cardiac arrest after staff served a normal dinner; the hospital has apologised and stood down two staff.

zh.headline: 威院病人需糊餐卻獲正常餐 哽喉後不治
zh.dek: 54歲認知障礙男病人入院後被餵正常晚餐，出現哽喉及心臟停頓，同日深夜離世；院方已向家屬致歉，兩名涉事員工暫時調離崗位。

en.headline: QEH relocation to Kai Tak Hospital will be seamless, health minister says
en.dek: Kai Tak Hospital begins services in two phases from next month, gradually absorbing clinical services from Queen Elizabeth Hospital while the King’s Park site becomes an ambulatory care centre.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：威院遷往啟德醫院將無縫過渡
zh.dek: 啟德醫院下月起分兩階段投入服務，逐步接收伊利沙伯醫院臨床服務；京士柏舊址將重建為首間綜合日間醫院。

en.headline: Driver arrested after light goods vehicle hits 72-year-old pedestrian in Tai Po
en.dek: The woman was knocked down at a pedestrian crossing on On Tai Road and remains unconscious in hospital; the 68-year-old driver faces a dangerous driving charge.

zh.headline: 大埔輕型貨車撞傷72歲女途人 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 事主於安泰路行人過路處被撞倒，頭部受傷昏迷送院；68歲男司機通過酒精測試後，因涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。

en.headline: Immigration and departments arrest 35 in week-long anti-illegal worker operations
en.dek: Officers searched restaurants, retail shops and renovation sites across the city from 11 to 17 September, detaining suspected illegal workers, employers and overstayers.

zh.headline: 入境處聯同多部門反黑工一周拘35人
zh.dek: 入境處聯同食環署、康文署、勞工處及警方於9月11日至17日在全港多區搜查食肆、零售店及裝修單位，拘捕懷疑非法勞工、僱主及逾期逗留人士。

en.headline: West Kowloon Picnic Fest opens for four weekends by the harbour
en.dek: The first edition runs from today until 11 October on the Art Park waterfront lawn, with food market stalls, live music, workshops and picnic gear rental.

zh.headline: 西九首辦野餐節 一連四個周末及假期舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區藝術公園海濱東草坪由今日起至10月11日舉行野餐節，設美食市集、音樂表演、工作坊及野餐用品租借。

en.headline: Australian CFA non-permanent judge William Gummow dies aged 83
en.dek: The Hong Kong Judiciary and legal bodies expressed deep sadness at the passing of the former High Court of Australia justice who sat on the Court of Final Appeal since 2013.

zh.headline: 終院非常任法官甘慕賢逝世 享年83歲
zh.dek: 司法機構及法律界對澳洲籍終審法院非常任法官甘慕賢辭世深表哀悼，他自2013年起出任終院非常任法官。

en.headline: Cardboard airport exhibition Runway 51 closes this weekend
en.dek: American artist Barminski’s full-scale cardboard airport installation at JPS Gallery in Central ends on 19 September, inviting visitors into a playful alien-transit fantasy.

zh.headline: 紙板機場裝置展「Runway 51」本周末結束
zh.dek: 美國藝術家 Barminski 於中環 JPS Gallery 打造的全尺寸紙板機場裝置將於9月19日閉幕，讓觀眾走進一個充滿外星過境幻想的空間。

en.headline: Talent schemes could add 1.2pc to GDP yearly, Lee says
en.dek: The chief executive told a radio programme that more than 300,000 people had arrived under various admission measures, with over half of those reaching the three-year mark willing to stay.

zh.headline: 李家超：人才計劃每年或為本地生產總值貢獻1.2%
zh.dek: 特首在電台表示，各項人才措施已吸引逾30萬人來港，約兩成來自海外，過半滿三年者有意留港。

en.headline: Red flags raised at five beaches over big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department advised swimmers to stay out of the water at Stanley Main, Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second beaches.

zh.headline: 因大浪 五個泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署宣布港島南區及西貢共五個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗，提醒市民勿在該處游泳。

en.headline: Man charged with murder over Heng Fa Chuen knife killing
en.dek: A 51-year-old man who surrendered after his 53-year-old wife was found dead with multiple stab wounds has been formally charged and appeared in court.

zh.headline: 杏花邨殺妻案 51歲男被控謀殺還押
zh.dek: 涉案男子周三晚到警署自首，承認以廚刀襲擊妻子，女事主倒斃單位內，今日被正式控以謀殺罪。

en.headline: Police seize HK$3.6m etomidate and 10 replica guns in Tai Po
en.dek: A 26-year-old British national and two local men were arrested after officers found powders, vape pods and imitation firearms in a village house and car park.

zh.headline: 大埔破毒品倉檢360萬元依托咪酯及10支仿製氣槍 3男被捕
zh.dek: 深水埗警區人員周四晚在大埔截查一名英籍男子，其後在村屋搜出大量依托咪酯、煙彈、製毒工具及仿製氣槍。

en.headline: Northern Link Spur Line Hong Kong section authorised for construction
en.dek: Transport secretary Chan May-po said the railway scheme had completed statutory procedures and works could start at any time, targeting simultaneous opening with the main line by 2034.

zh.headline: 北環線支線香港段鐵路方案獲授權進行
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，法定程序已完成，工程可隨時起動，目標與主線於2034年或之前同步開通。

en.headline: Fine and hot weekend expected as anticyclone holds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts mainly fine and dry conditions with daytime temperatures reaching 32 to 33 degrees over Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 周末天晴酷熱 最高氣溫33度
zh.dek: 天文台預料高空反氣旋持續影響，周六至周日大致天晴乾燥，日間酷熱，氣溫介乎27至33度。

en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance set for three nights from 24 September
en.dek: The incense-lit procession through Causeway Bay streets runs from the eve of Mid-Autumn to the following Saturday, with the main night reaching Victoria Park.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍下周四起一連三晚巡遊
zh.dek: 中秋迎月至追月夜於銅鑼灣大坑舉行，正日路線延伸至維園綵燈會，免費入場。

en.headline: Sun details 10,000 extra jobs under graduate launch scheme
en.dek: The labour secretary said firms would create posts on top of existing headcount, with the government covering one-third of pay up to HK$6,000 a month.

zh.headline: 孫玉菏詳述畢業生就業啟航計劃一萬個額外職位
zh.dek: 勞福局局長表示企業須在現有編制以外開設職位，政府資助三分一薪金，每月上限6,000元。

en.headline: Linn says Northern Metropolis bill would speed land production
en.dek: The development secretary said passing the ordinance would give officials more room to create ready land faster, with a 900-hectare target by 2030.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：北都條例草案通過後造地可更快更多
zh.dek: 發展局局長在電台表示，條例有助拆牆鬆綁，五年規劃訂下2030年北都產出900公頃熟地的約束性指標。

en.headline: Lee says government will study paying some mainland deals in yuan
en.dek: On radio, the chief executive said Hong Kong already handles most offshore yuan trades and should push the currency further into bonds, contracts and training fees.

zh.headline: 李家超：研究與內地部分合約或交易用人民幣
zh.dek: 特首在電台表示，香港已處理大部分離岸人民幣交易，下一步可把人民幣用到債券、合約及培訓開支。

en.headline: Reports say rebuilt Huanggang Port may open on 12 October
en.dek: Local reports said Hong Kong and Shenzhen are aiming for a Monday launch after Golden Week, though officials have not named an official date.

zh.headline: 傳重建皇崗口岸擬10月12日啟用
zh.dek: 本地報道引述消息指港深雙方瞄準國慶黃金周後的周一開通，但官方尚未公布確實日期。

en.headline: Kai Tak stadium wall lights up nightly ahead of Asian Games
en.dek: A 30-minute display on the main stadium facade runs at 8pm until 24 October, with free match screenings due to start when the Nagoya Games open on Saturday.

zh.headline: 啟德主場館外牆每晚上演亞運燈光展
zh.dek: 燈光展每晚8時至8時30分播放至10月24日，名古屋亞運周六開幕後，零售館將免費直播指定賽事。

en.headline: About 100 start-ups selected for Loop park mentorship
en.dek: The operator of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park said chosen firms will be guided for five to eight years by tenants including AstraZeneca and Hithium.

zh.headline: 河套創科園篩選約100間初創 將獲五年至八年導師計劃
zh.dek: 港深創新及科技園營運方表示，入園初創將由阿斯利康及海辰儲能等進駐企業提供導師支援。

en.headline: Man, 45, dies after rescue off Kwun Tong public pier
en.dek: Rescuers pulled an unconscious man from the water on Thursday night after a report that someone had fallen into the sea. He was later certified dead at hospital.

zh.headline: 觀塘公眾碼頭救起45歲男子 送院後不治
zh.dek: 救援人員週四晚上在碼頭對開海面救起昏迷男子，送往聯合醫院後證實死亡，警方正調查事發經過。

en.headline: Eight arrested as police raid baccarat den on Lai Chi Kok Road
en.dek: Mong Kok officers seized a baccarat table, about HK$20,000 in cash and chips worth about HK$220,000 in an operation codenamed Fullboom.

zh.headline: 荔枝角道搗百家樂賭檔 8人被捕檢22萬簫碼
zh.dek: 旺角警區特別職務隊行動代號「蓄勢」，在荔枝角道單位檢獲百家樂賭柯、約2萬元現金及面值約22萬元簫碼。

en.headline: Police seize HK$450,000 of drugs in Tsuen Wan industrial flat
en.dek: A 23-year-old mainland man was arrested after officers found ketamine, cocaine and etomidate vape pods in a Sha Tsui Road unit used as a stash, police said.

zh.headline: 荃灣工廈搜出45萬元毒品 23歲內地男涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 荃灣警區特別職務隊週四晚上在沙咀道工廈單位檢獲氯胺酮、可卡因及依托咪酯煙彈，拘捕一名23歲內地男子。
